text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mooorning!! Alright, I'll do my best as 
class rep today too!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Class Rep. You can't push yourself 
that hard, no way! You should take a break 
every once in a while too."

text_block_list.name: Kind Classmate
text_block_list.text:
If you push yourself too hard in class and 
in races, you'll burn out, so the rest of 
the class will cover your rep duties for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Your devotion to the Class Rep has 
reached me! If so, then I shall gladly 
become a fellow student!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone~ Class is about to 
start~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oops! Please hold on, Teacher! As class 
representative, first I must clean the 
blackboard..."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, hey! You're "just a student," 
right?! I'm on duty today, so let me 
handle it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! Th-That's right... I am merely a 
student...

Her classmates' well-intentioned actions 
ended up becoming an unimaginable ordeal 
for someone who was a class representative 
to her very core.
